body.purpose: Everything staff reads. 0.875rem in UI, 1rem in documents and dialogs.

display.purpose: Marketing headlines and hero numbers only. Never inside staff workflows.

label.purpose: Micro-labels on buttons and form labels. New controls speak sentence case.

dos: Do keep button and dialog copy fixed and compact; render project, organization, and user names only in dedicated truncating surfaces (titles, title attributes), never inside controls.
Do use the `link-prose` utility (or the Button `link` variant) for every content link — gold underline, generous focus, always visible affordance.
Do mark numerals tabular in data (`tabular-nums`) and keep dates non-wrapping.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — every animation ships a gentler variant, and calm zones opt out of hover motion entirely.
Do animate opacity, transform, and background-color only; the CTA breath lives on a blurred `::before` layer so only opacity animates.
donts: Don't interpolate payload data into button labels, dialog titles-as-actions, or any control whose width must stay predictable.
Don't use display type (Inter Black hero sizes), aura washes, or the CTA breath inside staff workflows — they belong to brand surfaces.
Don't animate `box-shadow` (it janks under load) or bare-element selectors (navigation needs no exemption list).
Don't let the spec's unused vibes (`plum`, `royal`) back in — the code owns four themes: light, midnight, violet, dark.
Don't invent one-off tokens; stop at what is reused. The frontmatter is normative — a value lives in exactly one place.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight administration, ember accents only as state or signal.
Predictable controls: fixed copy, generous focus, no payload inside labels.
Tonal depth: flat surfaces, hairline rings, glow reserved for brand moments.
Bilingual by construction: seven locales, wrapping-safe, tabular numerals.
narrative.overview: Cost Tracker looks like the desk it replaces: a calm, well-lit counter where every figure is traceable and every decision is signed. Daylight Erasmus blues carry the working day; ember amber appears only where action lives — a hover, a focus ring, a single call to action. Nothing glows for decoration. The interface speaks softly and guides firmly: fixed, predictable controls, sentence-case data, tabular numerals, and generous focus states that make keyboard work first-class.

rules.body: Glow and shadow appear only as state — hover lift, focus, the breathing CTA. A surface that glows at rest is a bug.
rules.name: The Sacred Glow Rule

rules.body: Ember Amber is used sparingly in light (eyebrows, seals, washes); its rarity is the point. If everything is amber, nothing is.
rules.name: The One Voice Rule

rules.body: Controls guide in plain sentence case; ember encourages, it never shouts. Display type stays out of workflows.
rules.name: The Guiding Voice Rule

rules.body: Numerals in data are always tabular (`tabular-nums`); a column of amounts must never wobble.
rules.name: The Figures Line Up Rule

rules.body: Every protected view lives inside the same centered shell and spacing rhythm; full-bleed is reserved for brand moments, never for workflows.
rules.name: The Shell Holds Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadow and glow arrive only as a response to state (hover, focus, confirmation). Calm zones opt out of even hover lift.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule

rules.body: Interactive controls round at 14px, containing surfaces at 18px. Anything rounder must earn the pill; anything sharper must earn the edge.
rules.name: The Fourteen-Eighteen Rule
